hooks.name: manifest-permission-audit

action.command: node -e "const m = require('./manifest.json'); if(!m.manifest_version || m.manifest_version !== 3) throw new Error('Must be Manifest V3'); console.log('Manifest V3 check passed.');"

hooks.description: Verifies manifest structure and permissions conformance.
